notes.title: Driftwatch 1.2 Patch notes - New levels!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637738/773fec0f2ace4805467adfc1b9faed69ba8becbe.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637738/897524acef5d2425888f304d99c7679ff434adb6.png

New weapon instructions:

The blue bar represents mana
Mana regenerates
Staff and shield both use mana
Shield size (and mana consumption) both depend on how far you depress the trigger

General:

Fixed bug, Wyverns were not counted towards the health spawn killcounter
Rewrote the killstreak code for better performance
Increased number of preloaded assets to reduce lagspikes at level starts
Tweaks to reduce killstreak abusing
Fixed Wyvern death anim
Fixed bug with Health pickup balloons ignoring hits
Small optimizations in Hovergoblin code
Small optimizations in Wyvern code

Splash:

Visual changes

Menu:

Unlocked Level 3 orb

Tutorial 2:

Changed next level orb to link to tutorial 3 instead of 4

Tutorial 3:

Added!

Level 2:

Fixed Healthpickups having wrong spawneffect

Level 3:

Added!

Level 4:

Fixed Healthpickups having wrong spawneffect
Reduced snow effect for performance

notes.title: Driftwatch 1.1 Patch Notes - New option
notes.content:
General:

You can now disable the ‘Next level’ sphere by opening the settings menu (press touchpad on your Vive controller), go to ‘options’ -> ‘Gameplay’ -> disable next level sphere.
Fixed bug where health particle systems would stack.
The 3rd level is still in development.

Menu:

Small changes to improve performance

Level 1:

Small changes to improve performance

notes.title: Driftwatch patch 0.3 - New levels!
notes.content:
General:

Fireball tutorial added!
Level 4 Added! Shoot Wyverns with balls of fire!
Reduced longshot distance from 50 to 40
Fixed scores not uploading correctly when quitting level instead of dying
Increased enemy hover platform collider size

Menu:

Level plank names changed for clarity
Unlocked Level 4 sphere

Tutorial 1:

Visual tweaks

Tutorial 2:

Visual tweaks
Unlocked next tutorial sphere

Level 1:

Tweaks to level colliders
Improved aerial waypoints for flying enemies, they will now stay closer to the player

notes.title: Driftwatch patch 0.2
notes.content:
General:

Increased health pickup size for easier hitting
Improved collision between crashing platforms and environment
Fixed highscores not being uploaded correctly to leaderboard

Tutorial 1:

Improved statistics tracking
Controller tooltips no longer disappear on scene start

Tutorial 2:

Improved statistics tracking

Level 1:

Fixed floating spawn point
Fixed statistic tracking for Level 1 startups and related achievements

Level 2:

Fixed statistic tracking for Level 2 startups and related achievements
Tweaks to aerial waypoints + level objects to prevent unwanted collisions between level and aerial units
